newsitem.title: USA: Sodak Q4 hurt by product delays, weather.
newsitem.headline: Sodak Q4 hurt by product delays, weather.

text.p: Sodak Gaming Inc, which markets gaming equipment and operates casinos and gaming halls, said Thursday its fourth quarter results were hurt by delays in product shipments and unusually severe winter weather in the upper Midwest.
Sodak's fourth quarter was also impacted by an unanticipated increase in operating expenses relating to gaming operations in Peru and an increase in the allowance for doubtful accounts.
Earlier, Sodak reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.05 a share, down from $0.21. For the year, it earned $0.58 a share, compared with $0.57 a year ago.

"This past year has been extremely important as we continue our transformation into a comprehensive, full-service, vertically-integrated gaming operations company," Michael Wordeman, chairman, said in a statement.
He added Sodak has expanded its Latin American presence in three countries.
Sodak said its product sales for all of 1996 hit a record high of 12,350 devices and record sales of $104.5 million, up from $73.2 million in 1995.
